{{Otheruses|Bnar}}
{{Quote|I was looking for a fabled artifact. The Force crystal of Naga Sadow or the Journals of Ood Bnar or maybe just a really well-made bantha burger. I forget what it was. But after searching crate after crate after crate for hours and days and weeks, I found nothing. Nothing!! I finally gave up and retired.|[[Riyan Kiner]], to a spacer|<ref name="SWG:TMHP1">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=general|The Meatlumps Hideout, Part 1|Corellia}}</ref>}}
The '''Journals of Ood Bnar''' was a series of journals presumably written by [[Ood Bnar]],<ref name="SWG:TMHP1" /> a legendary [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] who lived during the time of the [[Great Sith War/Legends|Great Sith War]].<ref name="TCSWE">{{CSWECite|I|82|Bnar, Master Ood}}</ref> Although the existence of the Journals of Ood Bnar was debated by the time of the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], it was still sought by treasure hunters. The explorer [[Riyan Kiner]] became utterly insane after spending his life looking for this fabled artifact.<ref name="SWG:TMHP1" />
